description: Cools without ice. Convenience on the go. The Igloo 12V portable electric cooler is ideal for truckers, vacations, road trips, RV's, boats and more. And with the 110VAC converter, it's perfect to bring inside the hotel or for use in the dorm room. Convection cooling fan circulates cold air, allows plastic bottles to cool as much and as quickly as cans. Excellent cooling performance cools down to 38 degree Fahrenheit below ambient temperature. Dual orientation, ice chest or refrigerator. Plugs into any 12V auto plug adapter. Swing-up side handles for easy carrying. Adjustable shelf. Quiet long-lasting brushless motor. Wipe interior and exterior surfaces clean before storing and between uses. To prevent stains and odors, empty cooler of contents after use.
